t: Soft-grip handle for additional comfort whilst working. Suitable for heavy duty staples. Quick jam-clearing mechanism saves time and effort. Pressure adjuster for applying staples to various surfaces. Features a built-in belt hook that clips onto tool kits or belts for ease of use. Made from tough materials and includes a lock-down handle for tidy storage in the toolbox. Supplied with 1000 x 10mm staples.
